stem.en: The Torrid Zone runs from the Tropic of Capricorn at 23½°S to the Tropic of Cancer at 23½°N. How many degrees of latitude does it cover?

explanation.en: The two tropics lie on opposite sides of the equator, so add the two distances: 23.5 + 23.5 = 47 degrees of latitude.

hints.en: One tropic is north of the equator and the other is south of it.
Add the distance from the equator to each tropic.
